f4b4bb981e:163b065d3b29a229.title: Vexto - Incident Response Desktop App UI UX
f4b4bb981e:163b065d3b29a229.summary: Vexto is a desktop app that gives our dispatch team real-time visibility into every vehicle in the fleet. It brings live GPS tracking, accident detection, and webcam verification into one system, so we can confirm incidents faster, respond with full context, and keep the whole operation under control. The project moved from fleet data audit to system architecture, incident logic, and map-based UX flows. Time was spent aligning live GPS, accident detection, and webcam feeds into one platform. The deepest work was structuring real-time logic that stays reliable at scale. We prioritized map-first navigation over list-based menus, since dispatchers think in location, not records. Analysis showed incident context mattered more than raw data, so we surfaced vehicle status, connectivity, and live webcam access in one card ? cutting verification time and improving response control.

f4b4bb981e:45ba4d56110252b6.title: Global Digital Collaboration Conference
f4b4bb981e:45ba4d56110252b6.summary: Visual identity for the Global Digital Collaboration Conference 2026 in Geneva. GDC brings together governments, international organisations, technology companies and other stakeholders to collaborate on the digital infrastructure and standards that increasingly connect our world. At the heart of the identity is the Global Barcode, an idea conceived by GDC founder Daniel Goldscheider. It translates the flags of all UN member states into simple vertical colour codes, based on the colours and their proportions within each national flag. Put together, they form one global code. And one very, very long flag. This became the starting point for the visual identity: an endless flag that folds, bends and winds its way through posters, spaces, shirts, lanyards and the conference itself. For the participant badges, the principle became personal: each name generates its own individual colour code.

f4b4bb981e:eaf91ce84cda68fb.title: Bradesco - São João
f4b4bb981e:eaf91ce84cda68fb.summary: We were invited by Lovely to create this São João campaign for Bradesco, inspired by the friendly rivalry between Caruaru and Campina Grande, home to two of Brazil's biggest June festivals. Building on the campaign concept, we developed a visual language inspired by Northeastern Brazilian folk culture and the tradition of repente, a form of improvised poetic dueling built around rhymes, wit, and playful provocation. We created a series of handcrafted illustrations that bring these two cities together, exploring the colors, shapes, and visual elements associated with São João celebrations. Each composition was designed to capture the spirit of rivalry while also celebrating a sense of unity. The result is a series of pieces that turn rivalry into connection and visually express the campaign's central message: the greatest São João is the one we create together.

f4b4bb981e:ec58b8cd447803b8.title: FoundersCard
f4b4bb981e:ec58b8cd447803b8.summary: FoundersCard has built a unique proposition around access?connecting an ambitious community of entrepreneurs and business leaders with exceptional benefits, experiences, and opportunities. Our challenge was to create a digital experience that felt as considered and valuable as the membership itself. We began by rethinking the experience from the ground up. Stripping away complexity, sharpening the hierarchy, and creating a clearer way to communicate the breadth of the FoundersCard world. The goal was simple: make something premium without feeling exclusive for the sake of it, and sophisticated without becoming complicated. A new visual language brought that thinking to life. Bold typography, confident layouts, elevated imagery, and a more editorial approach gave the brand greater presence and personality. A flexible design system created consistency across the experience while leaving room for partners, benefits, destinations, and stories to each have their own moment.

a4977d3fa4:99ce9dc04be76b3e.title: JD and Nike Are Dedicating This Year’s 1.10 Day to Liverpool
a4977d3fa4:99ce9dc04be76b3e.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:99ce9dc04be76b3e.summary: JD has joined forces with Nike for the brand’s second annual 1.10 Day. A celebration of the staple Air Max 95, this year it revolves around the silhouette’s long-standing home of Liverpool, UK.Every sneakerhead knows Liverpool’s connection with the Air Max 95 goes back decades. But for those less familiar, the city’s obsession with the silhouette began in the ‘90s when football fans adopted it as part of their uniforms. It wasn’t until the retail price rose to £110 GBP that it continued to grow as a cultural icon, becoming widely known in the North of England as the 110. Honoring its enduring presence in the city, the sportswear retailer recently enlisted a lineup of local trailblazers for its dedicated 1.10 Day campaign. Headed by Liverpool F.C. footballer Dominik Szoboszlai, former Everton player Duncan Ferguson, rapper Kasst 8, and host Still Ryan as well as a wider cast of Ben Harris and Mark Skully from Bennetts, collector Lola Bennett, sneaker boutique owner Block P, model Paris Chanel, and creator Lew Earle, the collective comes together for a family-style portrait that spotlights the diverse communities connected by the Air Max 95. View this post on InstagramA post shared by JD Sports (@jdsports) The campaign also features a short film directed by UK filmmaker Glenn Kitson. It explores how the silhouette is passed down through generations as a cultural baton, pairing Kitson’s signature snappy cuts with a narration by writer and recovery worker PJ Smith. Beyond the storytelling, the film gives fans a closer look at the highly anticipated Nike Air Max 95, made for Liverpool.Dropping exclusively at JD, the limited-edition pair marks the first time the city will get its own Air Max 95. Channeling its unmistakable spirit, Nike infuses the silhouette with two symbolic Liverpool hues, including the red brick-inspired “Rust Factor” and light-toned “Steam,” referencing the Liver Bird emblem. This color palette highlights “SCOUSE” on the sole, as well as the split…

a4977d3fa4:c1a7b0ba21f8e021.title: Louis De Guzman Reimagines the Jumpman for Jordan Brand’s Artist Series
a4977d3fa4:c1a7b0ba21f8e021.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:c1a7b0ba21f8e021.summary: Summary Louis De Guzman joins Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026.The Balikbayan box inspires a collection centered on family, migration and connection.Geometric Jumpman graphics and handwritten details translate De Guzman’s Filipino-American story into apparel. Chicago-based Filipino-American visual artist and designer Louis De Guzman is joining Jordan Brand’s Artist Series for Fall 2026 with an apparel collection rooted in family, migration and the Filipino tradition of the Balikbayan box.Titled around the concept “It Took This to Get Here,” the collaboration looks back to De Guzman’s childhood in the early 1990s, when he watched his parents pack boxes with photographs, Chicago Bulls T-shirts, shoes, trading cards and handwritten notes to send to relatives in the Philippines. Before video calls made long-distance communication immediate, these packages became a tangible connection between families separated by oceans — including De Guzman and his older brother, who was still living in the Philippines at the time. That personal history is translated into the collection through handwritten details inspired by names marked onto clothing tags, alongside the Jumpman reinterpreted through De Guzman’s signature geometric visual language and color palette.The capsule carries that narrative across a practical lineup of everyday apparel, including men’s and women’s tees, an oversized fleece hoodie, women’s fleece crew, fleece pants, cargo/utility pants, an anorak and a unisex cap. Prices range from $32 USD for the cap to $170 USD for the anorak, positioning each piece as part of a broader wardrobe rather than a singular commemorative item. For De Guzman, the project reflects nearly four decades of family history and the values embedded in the Balikbayan tradition - connection, generosity and carrying one’s roots forward - while extending an artistic practice that frequently brings together his family’s immigrant journey and his own experience growing up as a…

a4977d3fa4:4efaa9d102ca3eda.title: Zendaya and On Unveil Second Co-Created Apparel and Footwear Collection
a4977d3fa4:4efaa9d102ca3eda.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:4efaa9d102ca3eda.summary: Summary On and Zendaya have officially launched their second co-created collection developed alongside Law RoachThe capsule introduces technical sportswear with custom python prints and debuts the Cloudnova Moon Mary JaneThe lineup launches globally on October 1 accompanied by immersive retail pop-ups in Los Angeles Paris Tokyo and Chengdu On and Zendaya have officially released their second co-created footwear and apparel collection, accompanied by an action film-inspired campaign. Developed alongside longtime collaborator Law Roach, the latest drop elevates everyday activewear by fusing On's performance innovation with signature styling elements.Captured in a cinematic short film by directing trio Pantera, the collection puts movement and versatility center stage. The apparel lineup introduces an all-over custom python print across a bodysuit, a form-fitting long-sleeve top, and a half-zip anorak. Additionally, oversized crew necks and matching sweatpants incorporate considered ruching and adjustable bungee cord detailing to allow wearers to customize each silhouette.Footwear highlights the launch with the debut of the Cloudnova Moon in a Mary Jane-inspired design. The low-profile model pairs an engineered knit upper with refined speed laces for all-day comfort. The silhouette debuts in three distinct colorways: "Clove/Ivory," "Dew/Antler," and "Black/Ivory."The Zendaya x On collection is available starting October 1, 2026, online, On retail stores globally, and special pop-up spaces in Los Angeles, Paris, Tokyo, and Chengdu. a4977d3fa4:aab0fde68ff75e77.title: Hankook Tire Is on Hand to Kit Out Your Electric Car With iON Evo
a4977d3fa4:aab0fde68ff75e77.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:aab0fde68ff75e77.summary: Demand for the latest electric vehicles may have surged in recent years, but the development of EV tires hasn’t always kept up with this rapidly evolving technology. Hankook, however, is looking to bridge this gap with its iON Evo tires.Launched as part of its wider iON range, the high-performance tires are specially engineered around distinctive EV components, including weight and torque, to make drives more energy efficient. A key element in the design is the brand’s revolutionary ProDurable Compound material. Made from advanced fillers and flexible rubber materials, it can withstand the heavier battery weight of EVs, helping to keep wear and tear at bay over the tires’ lifespan. Beyond the core demands of EVs, Hankook also considers the noticeably quieter experience of riding in these cars compared to ICE vehicles. With tires often adding a layer of noise to the journey, the iON Evo tires incorporate i Sound Absorber Technology with Opti Pitch Technology to reduce tread sound no matter the speed or size of the car. This is paired with Advanced Handling and Reduced Rolling Resistance to provide an all-round smooth journey for both the driver and passengers. Hypebeast captured the latest tires in a new Closer Look with the BMW iX3. See how they perform on the road in the video below. Find out how to purchase the Hankook iON Evo tire range by visiting its website now. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:169ddec54fc42b6e.title: Feid and Salomon Unveil the ACS NEXXT "The Green Star"
a4977d3fa4:169ddec54fc42b6e.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:169ddec54fc42b6e.summary: Summary Salomon and brand ambassador Feid have officially announced the ACS NEXXT The Green Star by FeidThe technical silhouette incorporates a cow-pattern outsole in Feid's signature Ferxxo green iridescent chrome details and his hand-drawn signatureA Queens pop-up runs October 2 through October 4 ahead of the global October 10 launch Salomon and Latin GRAMMY-winning artist Feid have officially unveiled the Salomon ACS NEXXT: The Green Star by Feid, marking the next phase of their ongoing partnership. The progressive footwear project fuses Salomon's technical outdoor heritage with the Colombian musician's signature visual universe.Evolving from the foundation laid by the ACS PRO, the ACS NEXXT retains the brand's trademark Agile Chassis System and recognizable caged upper while reinterpreting the franchise for a lifestyle audience. The design features a cow-pattern outsole executed in Feid’s signature "Ferxxo" green, contrasted by iridescent chrome accents across the upper. Adding a personal touch, Feid's hand-drawn signature is stitched directly onto the woven tongue label.To celebrate the arrival of the shoe, Salomon is hosting a pop-up activation in Queens, New York, from Friday, October 2 through Sunday, October 4. a4977d3fa4:79c1439a6d83b969.title: Joel Lyall Is Flipping His Daily Routine to Stay Ahead of the Fashion Game
a4977d3fa4:79c1439a6d83b969.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:79c1439a6d83b969.summary: “When everyone else has gone to bed, it always comes back to why I started this,” shares Joel Lyall. The stylist and founder of vintage streetwear boutique Bythepeace is busy unloading fresh stock from his car outside his studio in West London. “Six years ago, I was working from my brother’s room at night, staying motivated to get things done. Now, this time of day is a reminder to keep pushing and persevering.”Hypebeast links up with Lyall at the start of the evening for a new campaign with UGG. As the pace of the city slows down, he lets us into what he considers the peak of his working day. From ideating streetwear looks to preparing vintage garments for sale, the visuals capture how the stylist seizes new opportunities at nightfall, while kitted out in the brand’s functional yet fashion-forward Fall 2026 collection. "This time of day is a reminder to keep pushing and persevering."Surrounded by almost 70 pieces from various stockists, Lyall wastes no time in getting to work. “Sometimes I start by measuring and steaming the clothes, other times I note it all down on my spreadsheet, and that's just the beginning,” he shares. With his evening in full swing, the stylist relies on the UGG Birch Hiker for long-lasting comfort. A low-top, utilitarian shoe originating from the 1999 Birch Collection, the silhouette has been reworked with durable materials to support active lives like Lyall’s. As he mentions, organizing garments is just the beginning, so after separating them into what can be styled for upcoming projects or archived for future collections, he begins posting pieces to the website. “I upload around 9 p.m. whilst my customers are in bed and may be scrolling through what they can buy,” he explains. “People are especially active through the night, so that's when I can take advantage and get ahead of the game, making sure they see my items first.”At this point, Lyall switches to the UGG Birch Boot. Though it's built with a waterproof outer, the lightweight…

a4977d3fa4:bded6c6d8cac7162.title: Dom Pérignon's Latest Limited Edition Bottle Comes from Damien Hirst
a4977d3fa4:bded6c6d8cac7162.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:bded6c6d8cac7162.summary: Dom Pérignon has enlisted Damien Hirst for its end-of-year 2026 limited edition. The release covers two vintages, Dom Pérignon Vintage 2018 and Rosé Vintage 2010, both dressed in artwork drawn from the British artist's Kaleidoscope series. The collaboration centres on the house's familiar shield-shaped label. Hirst has filled it with a dense, symmetrical pattern that repeats across the bottle and its gift box. The shield stays in place, but it is now one element in a larger repeating composition rather than a plain frame. A black neck collar reads "Limited Edition" above Hirst's signature.Each vintage gets its own colour. Vintage 2018 comes in deep blues and violets, which the house links to infinity and spirituality. Rosé Vintage 2010 takes a palette of magenta, red and pink, meant to reflect the Pinot Noir at the heart of the blend. Matching boxes carry the full kaleidoscope pattern, with the shield set at the centre in silver.Hirst is the latest in a long run of artists and creators to work with the house over nearly three decades. Earlier names include Andy Warhol, Marc Newson, Jeff Koons, the estate of Jean-Michel Basquiat, Takashi Murakami, Karl Lagerfeld, David Lynch, Lenny Kravitz and Lady Gaga.The Dom Pérignon x Damien Hirst Vintage 2018 Limited Edition Gift Box is priced at £230, and the Rosé Vintage 2010 Limited Edition Gift Box at £405. Both are available now from Selfridges in London. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.title: G-Shock Unveils the $80,000 USD MRG-D5000 Crafted Entirely in Blue Sapphire
a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:91f1557e62bed9db.summary: Summary G-Shock has officially unveiled the MRG-D5000 featuring an outer case and bezel rendered entirely in synthetic blue sapphire crystalConceived by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 the shock-resistant timepiece required nearly a decade of technical developmentProduction is strictly limited to 20 pieces globally with each watch hand-assembled by a single master technician at Casio's Yamagata factory Casio G-Shock has officially revealed the G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire, marking the most expensive production watch in the brand's history. Priced at $80,000 USD (£67,000 GBP), the record-setting model turns a long-standing concept envisioned by brand creator Kikuo Ibe in 2017 into an ultra-exclusive reality.Constructed entirely from lab-grown blue sapphire crystal across its outer case and bezel, the G-Shock MRG-D5000 measures 16.45mm in thickness to accommodate the material's structural requirements. To prevent fracturing without relying on traditional drill holes or screws, G-Shock engineered an interlocking assembly framework inspired by traditional Japanese timber joinery. Each sapphire element interlocks like a three-dimensional puzzle to absorb and disperse impact forces while maintaining 200-meter water resistance and solar-powered functionality.The design stays faithful to the original 1983 square silhouette, featuring a blue vapor-deposition brick-pattern face detailed with 24-carat gold lettering. Flipping the watch over reveals a Grade 5 titanium caseback set with sapphire crystal, engraved with "DREAM PROJECT" alongside its individual edition number from 1/20 to 20/20. Every timepiece in the 20-piece release is hand-assembled by a single senior technician at Casio's Yamagata facility.The G-Shock MRG-D5000 Blue Sapphire is available in an ultra-limited production run of 20 pieces globally via G-Shock. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:afcc666aa270331f.title: Nike Officially Introduces the Apex Marathon Racing Shoe
a4977d3fa4:afcc666aa270331f.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:afcc666aa270331f.summary: Summary Nike has unveiled the Apex marathon shoe built for peak race-day efficiency and speedThe silhouette introduces double-stacked Air Zoom units in the forefoot paired with ZoomX LT foam and a 40mm zero-drop platformThe shoe officially launches globally in January 2027 via Nike and select stockists Nike has officially introduced the Nike Apex, marking its pinnacle expression of marathon race-day innovation. Built for competitive runners chasing every possible second, the lightweight racing system is engineered to deliver unprecedented energy return and forward propulsion.The Apex stands as Nike’s first racing shoe to incorporate four Air Zoom units configured in two double-stacked pairs under the forefoot—the most Air ever applied to a Swoosh running model. Designed to compress, store, and return energy, the system delivers up to 40% more energy return than the Alphafly 3 while weighing over 10% less. The shoe sits on a balanced 40-millimeter zero-drop platform to provide consistent support, cushioning, and responsiveness from heel to toe.Surrounding the Air Zoom setup is a bed of new ZoomX LT midsole foam, designed to be softer, lighter, and more responsive than traditional ZoomX. A raised, inverse-wave carbon fiber Flyplate directs loading directly into the stacked Air units, working alongside a wider outsole and rocker geometry to maintain pace stability. Up top, a breathable Flyknit X upper with a fitted knit collar and sockliner-free construction creates a minimal, glove-like fit, finished with GOATEK and Fast Shot traction underfoot.The Nike Apex launches in January 2027 via Nike and select retail locations. Click here to view full gallery at Hypebeast

a4977d3fa4:56b3d6dd73d9334f.title: Matières Fécales Presents "THE NINETY NINE PERCENT" SS27 Collection at Place de la République
a4977d3fa4:56b3d6dd73d9334f.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:56b3d6dd73d9334f.summary: Summary Matières Fécales staged its SS27 runway presentation titled THE NINETY NINE PERCENT at Paris's Place de la RépubliqueDesigned by Steven Raj Bhaskaran alongside Hannah Rose the collection featured 99 looks modeled entirely by people of colorThe show highlighted a footwear collaboration with Christian Louboutin alongside hand-woven textiles from Burkina Faso and India Matières Fécales has unveiled its Spring/Summer 2027 collection, titled "THE NINETY NINE PERCENT," staging the first-ever fashion show at the historic Place de la République during Paris Fashion Week. Conceived by designer Steven Raj Bhaskaran with support from creative partner Hannah Rose, the presentation served as a deeply personal manifesto honoring immigrant families, working-class communities, and marginalized identities through 99 looks modeled entirely by people of color.Structured across three distinct chapters—“FAMILY,” “TRIBE,” and “GODS”—the collection translates Bhaskaran's personal journey into elevated garments. The opening "FAMILY" segment introduced white draped ensembles, Thawb-inspired cotton dress shirts, hardware-accented silk trenches, and modest micro-pleated chiffon skirts. The section also debuted curved-heel flip-flop footwear created in collaboration with Christian Louboutin, closing with Bhaskaran walking the runway alongside his mother, sister, and niece.Transitioning into "TRIBE," the collection explored alternative youth culture with military tulle tweed sets, decaying lamb leather capes, metallic "Golden Touch" gloves, and heavy-duty "Stomper" combat boots. The final "GODS" section highlighted global artisanal techniques, featuring hand-woven cotton suits by Cabes Gie in Burkina Faso and hand-embroidered sarees by Tilfi in Varanasi, India, reimagined as decayed 1950s ball gowns. In a striking finale, models carried life-like billionaire figures around the République statue to Nina Simone’s "Tomorrow Is My Turn."A portion of sales from the Spring/Summer 2027…

a4977d3fa4:e64ed80ccbc69966.summary: Summary Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery are set to officially close their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026US District Judge Araceli Martínez Olguín approved a settlement with 12 state attorneys general removing the final legal barrierFormer Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz will join David Ellison as co-CEO to lead the combined entertainment conglomerate Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery are scheduled to officially complete their $111 billion USD merger on October 6, 2026. U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín signed off on a settlement agreement with 12 state attorneys general, eliminating the final legal hurdle blocking the largest corporate takeover in Hollywood history.The approved consent decree establishes specific operational parameters for the combined media empire rather than requiring asset divestitures. Key terms mandate that the merged entity cannot sell the historic Paramount Studios or Warner Bros. studio lots for at least five years, must commit an additional $300 million USD annually toward U.S. film production, and must release at least 30 feature films in theaters across the first two years. Furthermore, a dedicated news editorial independence board will be established to govern journalistic principles for both CBS News and CNN.Alongside the legal resolution, the executive structure of the combined conglomerate has been formalized. Paramount chief David Ellison has brought on former Mattel CEO Ynon Kreiz to serve as co-CEO, while HBO head Casey Bloys is expected to assume control of the unified streaming division. Outgoing Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav will step down as the merger officially closes.The transaction between Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery is set to close on October 6, 2026. The superstar brings one of the brand's oldest archival runners back into orbit, bridging the gap between 1971 track heritage and modern lifestyle appeal.First prototyped in 1971 for speed on the track, the Moon Shoe represents a foundational piece of Nike's performance history. The silhouette is defined by its signature waffle sole, a groundbreaking traction design that stems from co-founder Bill Bowerman’s earliest footwear experiments. Now reimagined and explicitly designed for life in orbit, the runner transitions from its competitive athletic origins into a contemporary footwear staple.In the newly revealed campaign imagery, LISA pairs the archival sneaker with a bold, red color-blocked ensemble. The styling emphasizes the shoe's low-profile construction, exposed traction elements, and classic vintage aesthetics. By bringing the 1971 design language back into clear view, the campaign successfully merges foundational athletic heritage with modern cultural relevance.The Nike Moon Shoe launches globally on October 1, 2026 via Nike. a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.title: Sotheby's Unveils $450 Million USD Collection Led by Rare Van Gogh, Cézanne, and Monet Works
a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:734a2ae688099a6d.summary: Summary Sotheby's will offer the 12-piece Blaquier-Arrieta Collection in New York with an estimate in the region of $450 million USDThe historic offering features rare works by Vincent van Gogh Paul Cézanne and Claude Monet unseen publicly for over 50 yearsVan Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs and Cézanne's Arlequin are both poised to set new global auction records for the artists Sotheby's has officially unveiled The Blaquier-Arrieta Collection, an extraordinary 12-piece group of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterworks estimated to realize in the region of $450 million USD. Unseen in public for over half a century, the historic assemblage is headlined by landmark paintings from Vincent van Gogh, Paul Cézanne, and Claude Monet.Leading the offering is Van Gogh's Châtaigniers en fleurs (Chestnut Trees in Blossom), painted in May 1890 during his final months in Auvers-sur-Oise and estimated in the region of $180 million USD. The canvas depicts a blossoming chestnut canopy and a solitary figure alongside women in Japanese attire, representing one of only eight Auvers landscapes remaining in private hands.Alongside Van Gogh's work is Cézanne's 1888–1890 oil painting Arlequin, estimated in the region of $120 million USD. Depicting the artist's 17-year-old son Paul in red and black diamond checks, it stands as the only composition from Cézanne's seminal four-part Harlequin series held outside of a museum collection. Both works are positioned to set new global auction records for the respective artists.The collection also features Claude Monet’s 1876 landscape Le Jardin des Tuileries, estimated between $15 million and $20 million USD. Painted from a fifth-floor apartment on the Rue de Rivoli, it is one of only two Paris cityscapes from the series remaining in private hands. a4977d3fa4:6dd22d481d107b89.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:6dd22d481d107b89.summary: Summary Netflix has released the official first trailer for its unscripted series 'The New Stanford Prison Experiment'The six-part experiment places 30 volunteers inside a real prison facility as assigned guards and inmatesThe series explores power dynamics hierarchy and human behavior starting October 21 Netflix has released the official first trailer for The New Stanford Prison Experiment, an upcoming unscripted series exploring power dynamics and systemic control. The six-part production places 30 volunteers inside an operational prison setting, reviving the core premise of Philip Zimbardo's famous 1971 study.Produced by Alfred Street Industries, the series randomly divides its 30 participants into guards and prisoners within an active correctional environment. The trailer highlights escalating tension as the subjects adapt to their roles, examining whether moral endurance and empathy can withstand institutional power structures.The project is executive produced by Jane Lipsitz, Dan Cutforth, Nan Strait, Dan Volpe, Jeff Grogan, and Mike Odair. Comprising six 45-minute episodes, the show offers a modern reality-based iteration of one of social psychology's most famous experiments.The New Stanford Prison Experiment premieres globally on October 21, 2026, exclusively on Netflix. a4977d3fa4:668ef4d7ad7c361e.summary: The Presidents Cup is a team competition, but it is also one of the few moments in golf where the game’s international reach becomes especially visible. This year, as the U.S. Team faced the International Team with players from Canada, Latin America, South Korea, Japan, Australia and New Zealand, Chicago served as the backdrop for a tournament built around different countries, playing styles and relationships to the sport.That sense of exchange extended beyond Medinah Country Club. Roughly an hour from the course, Hypegolf hosted a Presidents Cup watch party at Five Iron Golf, bringing guests together in the middle of the city as the competition unfolded. The event offered a more social way into the week, reflecting how plenty of people now encounter golf through simulators, style, conversation and a shared interest in the game.The room brought together people with very different connections to golf. Roger Steele, Drew Westphal and Ashley Mayo were among the guests, joining a crowd that spanned industry figures, creatives and newer voices in the sport. It made for a setting where people could keep an eye on the action from Medinah while putting their own spin on the experience upstairs at Five Iron.Guests moved between the venue’s simulators, a photo booth and a merchandise display, while a Hypegolf-curated food and drink program kept the evening moving. Light bites were served alongside a cocktail menu featuring a margarita, an Old Fashioned and a non-alcoholic option. The format was intentionally loose allowing people to hit balls, catch up with friends or settle in to follow the matches.The details also created a connection back to the tournament site. Floral arrangements from Derrick Rose’s Rose’s Flower Shop were placed throughout the event, echoing the first-tee presentation at Medinah. The collaboration brought an unmistakably Chicago element to both settings, tying the week’s golf programming to one of the city’s most recognizable sporting figures.Style…

a4977d3fa4:b0e23bb76a6b8cec.title: InScope Is a New Art Fair That Should Be on Your Radar
a4977d3fa4:b0e23bb76a6b8cec.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b0e23bb76a6b8cec.summary: Summary InScope, formerly Scope Art Show, will open its inaugural edition from December 1 through December 6 during the upcoming Miami Art WeekThe fair is designed to make collecting personal, allowing for deeper connections between artists, galleries, and collectorsProgramming includes talks, performances, tours, wellness events, and large-scale feature projects from Alake Shilling, Aurora Mititelu, Blue Floor Project, Ceren Arslan, Jason Hackenwerth, Nurse, Rabi Towing, and Swoon InScope is the new fair joining Miami this December, and, designed for discovery, it’s looking to shake things up during the city’s upcoming Art Week.The inaugural edition will hit the sands on Ocean Drive at 8th Street between December 1 and 6, planting its indoor and outdoor art installations, gallery pavilions, and social spaces across 220,000 square feet. Built around curiosity and connection, the event introduces a new format designed to bring artists, galleries, and collectors together in encounters that feel personal. “Art gives those conversations a starting point,” said InScope’s CEO and Co-founder Matt Middleton. “Our ambition is for people to leave with the relationships they came for and the inspiration they didn’t expect.”While the full gallery list is coming soon, its day-to-night programming so far offers a promising mix of talks, performances, tours, and wellness events. And its Feature Projects roster is already looking stacked. The first wave of announced projects includes Alake Shilling (Tlaloc Studios), Aurora Mititelu, Blue Floor Project (Fuze and Baha Mar), Ceren Arslan, Jason Hackenwerth (CAMP Gallery), Nurse (Walshy Fire), Rabi Towing, and Swoon.And while this marks the debut edition, the minds behind it aren’t the new kids on the block. Headed by Middleton, Alexis Hubshman, Hayley River Smith, and the former SCOPE Art Show team, InScope leans on 25 years of championing artists and galleries to reconsider and create space for diverse perspectives and experiences.…

a4977d3fa4:f3f474aa34b5abc7.title: Maison Margiela’s Tokyo-Exclusive REPLICA Fragrance Smells Like an Unsent Letter
a4977d3fa4:f3f474aa34b5abc7.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:f3f474aa34b5abc7.summary: Summary Maison Margiela’s “Letter Never Sent” captures the intimacy of an unsent message through a Tokyo 1995-inspired scent.Sumi ink, red cedarwood and white musk evoke ink, paper and lingering emotion.The Tokyo-exclusive fragrance launches October 1. Maison Margiela turns an unfinished thought into an olfactory memory with REPLICA “Letter Never Sent,” the house’s first fragrance created exclusively for Tokyo and the first Eau de Parfum within its REPLICA Memory Collection.Set in “Tokyo, 1995,” the woody-musky composition looks back to a moment when communication was beginning to shift from the physical to the digital: handwritten letters and faxed pages giving way to emails, while words once committed to paper could increasingly disappear as easily as a deleted draft. Against the glow and restless movement of the city, “Letter Never Sent” imagines something quieter — an unposted letter kept close, preserving feelings that were written down but never delivered.That scent unfolds through a deliberately restrained trio of notes. A sumi ink accord opens with a dry, mineral transparency and faint metallic sharpness, recalling the moment fresh ink meets white paper while mirroring the cool polish of Tokyo’s urban landscape. As that initial edge settles, red cedarwood introduces warmth, grain and depth, shifting the scene from neon-lit streets toward the intimacy of a desk late at night. White musk finally softens the composition into something clean and close to the skin, evoking the smooth sensation of fine paper between the fingers. The fragrance treats the unsent letter as something suspended between past and present — its ink still legible, its emotions unfinished, and its memory lingering quietly long after the city outside has moved on.The bottle retains REPLICA’s recognizable, utilitarian presentation, with its archival-style label identifying the memory as “Tokyo, 1995,” almost like a date and place recorded on a piece of correspondence. The understated…

a4977d3fa4:2dd94db9589f5d18.title: Erling Haaland's New Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite Only Shows Its True Colors When It Gets Wet
a4977d3fa4:2dd94db9589f5d18.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:2dd94db9589f5d18.summary: Name: Nike Phantom 6 Low Elite "Erling Haaland"Colorway: Baltic Blue/Glacier Blue/Blue EclipseSKU: HQ2332-401MSRP: $280 USDRelease Date: October 1Where to Buy: NikeNike is giving Erling Haaland a cleat that changes with the weather. The Phantom 6 Low Elite "Erling Haaland" arrives in Baltic Blue/Glacier Blue/Blue Eclipse. It pairs a water-activated color-changing upper with the performance package of Nike's precision-focused silhouette, and the whole concept is built around water as a metaphor for how the striker plays.The headline feature only appears once the grass is wet. The upper is printed with white ink that disappears on contact with water, revealing the full graphic hidden underneath. Nike ties the effect to Haaland himself, casting the reveal as a picture of a player who turns into something defenders can't contain. Dry, the cleat reads as a clean study in icy blues. Wet, it shows everything.That dual nature follows Nike's broader framing of Haaland as water: constantly shifting, capable of stillness one moment and a surge the next. The cold-toned palette of Baltic, Glacier, and Eclipse blues keeps the theme consistent before a single drop hits the upper.Underneath the concept, the construction is built for touch. Nike's Gripknit forms the upper, a tacky textured material designed to hold the ball whether conditions are wet or dry. It's a fitting pairing for a cleat that literally responds to rain, since the surface that changes appearance also keeps its grip when the weather turns.Traction and fit round out the spec sheet. A Cyclone 360 circular stud pattern sits in the forefoot to help players plant and pivot quickly. The shoe's frame is shaped for a more anatomical fit, particularly through the toe box, molding to the foot and bringing the wearer closer to the ball on strikes. Nike positions the Phantom 6 as an upgrade over the Phantom GX 2, with refined Gripknit touch zones, the more natural toe-box fit, and an improved Cyclone 360 plate. A cushioned…

a4977d3fa4:1a06b4decceb30b5.title: The Nike Moon Shoe OG Blooms With Florals Atop the Original Waffle Sole
a4977d3fa4:1a06b4decceb30b5.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:1a06b4decceb30b5.summary: Name: Nike Moon Shoe “Floral/Coconut Milk”Colorway: Coconut Milk/Mosswood Brown/Fennel/Light KhakiSKU: IZ6169-122MSRP: ¥15,730 JPY (approx. $100 USD)Release Date: October 1 (Japan), TBC (Global)Where to Buy: Nike JapanThe Nike Moon Shoe OG is returning with its heritage construction intact. Nike presents the shoe as a modern version of the running shoe Bill Bowerman built before the company even carried the Nike name, famously using his wife's waffle iron. This edition reproduces that original design in a Coconut Milk/Mosswood Brown/Fennel/Light Khaki colorway.The outsole is where the story starts. A rubber Waffle outsole anchors the shoe, and its gridded tread is the direct descendant of the pattern Bowerman first pressed out in the kitchen. The rubber gives durable traction, while the waffle pattern itself doubles as the shoe's clearest link to Nike's origins.The upper keeps things period-correct. It's built mainly from nylon, the lightweight material that defined running shoes of the era, and finished with a leather Swoosh along the side. The mix of textile and leather gives the upper a layered, textured look that separates it from the smooth, engineered surfaces of modern runners.The details stay simple inside, too. A foam sockliner handles step-in comfort, and the overall shape leans into the slim, low-slung stance of a '70s runner. The color blocking suits that vintage direction. Coconut Milk, Mosswood Brown, Fennel, and Light Khaki make up a muted, earthy palette that reads more like a lifestyle staple than a performance shoe, putting a piece of Nike's earliest history into an everyday rotation. a4977d3fa4:9b13835c6dd85caf.title: 'One Piece' Anime Enters Hiatus, Confirms Return in 2027 Following Major Cliffhanger
a4977d3fa4:9b13835c6dd85caf.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:9b13835c6dd85caf.summary: Summary Toei Animation has officially concluded the 2026 broadcast of the 'One Piece' anime following Episode 1180Episode 1181 will not air until 2027 adhering to the series' new 26-episode annual limit designed to improve pacingThe franchise maintains a packed 2027 lineup including Wit Studio's remake on Netflix and 'One Piece Film: God Valley' Toei Animation has officially paused the One Piece anime series for the remainder of 2026, confirming that Episode 1181 will not broadcast until 2027. The hiatus follows the September 27 airing of Episode 1180 on Fuji TV, which concluded on a major cliffhanger within the ongoing Elbaph arc.The broadcast pause forms part of a revamped scheduling strategy established by Toei Animation and producer Ryuta Koike. Under the structure, the long-running series is capped at 26 episodes annually to eliminate filler recap episodes and align the anime's pacing closer to Eiichiro Oda's original manga chapters. In the interim, Fuji TV will fill the Sunday night timeslot with Dragon Ball Super: Beerus starting October 11.Despite the main TV series hiatus, 2027 is shaping up to be a massive year for the broader franchise. The upcoming slate includes the debut of Wit Studio's THE ONE PIECE remake dropping seven episodes on Netflix in February, the theatrical premiere of One Piece Film: God Valley in Japan next summer, and season 3 of Netflix's live-action adaptation featuring Xolo Maridueña as Portgas D. a4977d3fa4:c66fbd2e87250a10.summary: Summary Street Fighter ’s latest featurette centers on Ken and Ryu’s fractured friendship and rivalry.Andrew Koji and Noah Centineo discuss the characters’ shared history and unresolved tension.The film hits U.S. theaters October 16, 2026. The historic result sets a new global benchmark for sports memorabilia as the most expensive game-worn NBA jersey ever sold at auction.Worn during Jordan's final championship campaign with the Chicago Bulls—immortalized as "The Last Dance"—the item stands as the only publicly known white 1998 NBA Finals jersey to ever surface on the open market. The physical piece features the iconic 1998 NBA Finals Championship patch stitched onto the chest, widely celebrated by sports collectors as the most significant Finals patch in modern basketball history.Bidding closed at 8:00 p.m. EDT on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, marking a monumental shift in the sports collectibles sector. Following the landmark jersey sale, JOOPITER's curated sports auction block continues with Jordan’s personal 1997 Ferrari 550 Maranello, which he drove during his final years in Chicago, scheduled to close on September 30.The 1998 NBA Finals Game 3 jersey was auctioned exclusively via JOOPITER, closing on September 29, 2026. a4977d3fa4:e8c5bddb568e84ce.title: Phillips Hong Kong Puts Three Career-Defining Works at the Center of Its Modern & Contemporary Art Evening Sale
a4977d3fa4:e8c5bddb568e84ce.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e8c5bddb568e84ce.summary: Summary Phillips’ Hong Kong Evening Sale brings together 20 modern and contemporary art lots.Gerhard Richter, Zeng Fanzhi and Zao Wou-Ki headline the auction.The sale takes place on today at Phillips’ West Kowloon headquarters. Phillips is bringing together a special selection of modern and contemporary art for its Hong Kong Evening Sale today with 20 lots spanning influential artists across generations and geographies. Held at the auction house’s Asia headquarters in West Kowloon, the sale is led by works from Gerhard Richter, Zao Wou-Ki and Zeng Fanzhi, each representing a formative moment within the artist’s practice. The broader lineup also includes names such as Hajime Sorayama, Lauren Quin, Natee Utarit, Yayoi Kusama and Issy Wood, with Phillips emphasizing rarity, provenance and art-historical significance across the offering.At the forefront is Gerhard Richter’s "Abstraktes Bild (522-1)" from 1983, estimated at $18 million - $25 million HKD (approx. $2.31 million - $3.21 million USD). Created during Richter’s celebrated “Wild Abstracts” period and the same year he relocated from Düsseldorf to Cologne, the work captures his increasingly mature use of the squeegee, layering vivid passages of color through a process that deliberately balances control and chance. Its provenance further distinguishes the painting: it was acquired directly from Richter by curator Kasper König and later included in the landmark Gerhard Richter. Bilder 1962–1985 retrospective, which travelled through major European institutions.Two significant Asian works further reinforce the sale’s focus on pivotal transitions. Zeng Fanzhi’s "Mask Series No. 4" from 1994, estimated at $11 million - $16 million HKD (approx. $1.41 million - $2.05 million USD), dates to the inaugural year of his now-iconic Mask series and features an unusually rare double-seated composition. Produced shortly after Zeng moved from Wuhan to Beijing, the painting uses its masked figures to reflect tensions around…

a4977d3fa4:e8395c1c64bff316.title: Anthony Vaccarello Drapes Saint Laurent in Gold for SS27
a4977d3fa4:e8395c1c64bff316.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:e8395c1c64bff316.summary: Summary Anthony Vaccarello presented the Saint Laurent Women's Summer 2027 collection enveloped entirely in shades of gold and deep blackThe range reinterprets iconic house archetypes including sahariennes trenches blouses and strong-shouldered tailoring through metallic fabrications A grand presentation at the Trocadéro and a poignant closing gesture fueled widespread industry speculation regarding Vaccarello's potential departure from the house Saint Laurent creative director Anthony Vaccarello has unveiled the Women's Spring/Summer 2027 Collection in Paris, taking over the iconic Trocadéro beneath the Eiffel Tower. Centered entirely around the transformative power of gold—a shade famously adored by Monsieur Yves Saint Laurent—the presentation explores the house’s archival codes through an intense, monochromatic lens.Vaccarello built the lineup by gilding foundational Saint Laurent archetypes across multiple decades. Classic sahariennes, trench coats, fluid blouses, and wrap skirts were shown alongside contemporary house signatures, such as voluminous blousons, razor-sharp suits edged with fur, and structured coats. The vast spectrum of gold—ranging from pale and Byzantine to matte, burnished, and Brutalist—was brought to life through lamé, organza, guipure lace, mousseline, brocade, jacquard, and gold-leaf-coated latex.The gilded theme extended seamlessly into the accessories, featuring filigree earrings and footwear constructed from metallic chains set atop snake-shaped heels. In the collection's final sequence, the luminous gold gave way to dramatic black velvet tailoring and nimbus cloud evening gowns.The sheer scale of the Trocadéro takeover, combined with a intimate closing moment where Vaccarello walked the runway and handed what appeared to be a key to a young boy in the audience, sparked widespread industry speculation that the show signaled his official exit from Saint Laurent. a4977d3fa4:865af96b24b0dcb7.title: "Raincoat Pikachu" Becomes the Second Most Expensive ‘Pokémon’ Card Ever at $8.4 Million USD
a4977d3fa4:865af96b24b0dcb7.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:865af96b24b0dcb7.summary: Summary A PSA 10 copy of the 2015 "Raincoat Pikachu" promo sold on Fanatics Collect after 64 bids, one of the biggest results the Pokémon card market has seenThe card was printed only as a prize for a fan artist, which kept it off retail shelves entirelyPrevious PSA 10 copies sold for low five figures as recently as last year, making this jump one of the hobby's steepest A PSA 10 Gem Mint copy of the 2015 Pokémon Japanese XY Promo Art Academy Fujishima Pikachu, known to collectors as "Raincoat Pikachu," has sold for $8.4 million USD including buyer's premium. The card closed on Fanatics Collect on September 28 after drawing 64 bids, a figure that reportedly places it behind only one other Pokémon card ever sold.The card's scarcity is built into its origin. Artist Y. Fujishima won the Dress-Up Pikachu category of a worldwide contest tied to the Nintendo 3DS game Pokémon Art Academy, beating out thousands of other entries. His prize was a run of 100 officially printed copies of his design. That means no pack, box, or store ever carried the card, and the total supply was fixed at 100 from the start.The artwork explains the nickname. Fujishima's design dresses Pikachu in a red slicker beneath an umbrella, a softer, storybook image compared with the franchise's standard battle-ready card art. On this copy, it comes paired with PSA's highest grade, a 10 Gem Mint, and the combination of a perfect grade and a supply capped at 100 is what drove the bidding.The price history shows how sharp the climb was. PSA 10 copies of the same card sold on Fanatics Collect for $12,600 USD in July 2024 and $19,200 USD in June 2025. The new result is roughly 440 times that 2025 sale, reached in about 15 months.Pikachu has been driving much of the market's recent heat. Just last week, a PSA 10 2002 Legendary Collection reverse holo Pikachu sold for $780,000 USD after trading at $264,000 USD in June, while a PSA 10 2006 Holon Phantoms Gold Star copy reached $480,000 USD, up from $148,800…

a4977d3fa4:b8b4cfdfd6ba4c7e.title: Miley Cyrus Ends a 13-Year Wait for a Billboard 200 No. 1 With ‘Bass Persuades’
a4977d3fa4:b8b4cfdfd6ba4c7e.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b8b4cfdfd6ba4c7e.summary: Summary Bass Persuades debuts at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, giving Miley her first chart-topping album since Bangerz in 2013Physical sales drove the launch, backed by a large spread of vinyl, CD, download, and cassette variantsRiley Green and beabadoobee both earned their first top 10 albums in a week shaped by new arrivals Miley Cyrus, now billed simply as Miley, is back at the top of the Billboard 200 for the first time in more than a decade as Bass Persuades debuts at No. 1 on the chart dated October 3. The album earned 61,000 equivalent album units in the US during the week ending September 24, per Luminate. It gives Miley her sixth No. 1 and her 16th top 10 album overall.Traditional album sales made up 47,000 of the album's units, enough to top the Top Album Sales chart as well, while SEA units added 14,000, the equivalent of 14.22 million on-demand official streams. TEA units contributed only a negligible amount. The sales figure got a clear boost from the variety of formats on offer: 16 vinyl variants and nine CD versions, each with one edition carrying a bonus track, plus six download editions (most with bonus material) and a cassette.The rollout moved quickly. Miley announced Bass Persuades on September 1 and shared its title track as the lead single two days later. That song entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 35 on the chart dated September 19, becoming her 24th top 40 hit. The album arrived on September 18, only a little over a year after Something Beautiful, which debuted and peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 dated June 14, 2025.Her previous chart-topper came in October 2013 with Bangerz. Her tally of six No. 1s and 16 top 10s spans releases billed as both Miley and Miley Cyrus, and it also counts her soundtrack albums recorded as Disney's Hannah Montana.The long gap puts Miley in company that keeps growing this year. She's the third act in 2026 to return to No. 1 after waiting at least a decade. Bruno Mars got there first on the March 14 chart,…

a4977d3fa4:ff4974b7d7c0dde4.title: JLR Unveils the Range Rover Sport Electric With 373 Miles of Range and a 22-Minute Fast Charge
a4977d3fa4:ff4974b7d7c0dde4.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:ff4974b7d7c0dde4.summary: Summary JLR unveils the all-electric Range Rover Sport Electric with dual motors delivering 542 hp and a 373-mile driving rangeAn 800-volt architecture supports 350 kW DC fast charging, juicing the 118.5 kWh battery from 10 to 80 percent in 22 minutesAdvanced suspension tech and a bespoke soundscape transition the performance SUV into the EV era without sacrificing off-road capability JLR unveiled the all-new Range Rover Sport Electric. This release represents a leap in the effort to transition the performance-oriented SUV into the electric era while maintaining traditional off-roading credentials. Built on an updated version of the Modular Longitudinal Architecture Flex (MLA-Flex) platform, the SUV draws power from a 118.5 kWh lithium-ion battery pack and an 800-volt electric system. Dual electric motors churn out 542 hp and 627 lb-ft of torque. When drivers engage Dynamic Launch Control, the EV accelerates from 0 to 62 mph in 4.5 seconds. By matching the acceleration of the supercharged V8 model, the electric variant proves that abandoning internal combustion does not mean sacrificing force.Beyond raw speed, the Range Rover Sport Electric is tuned for extended touring with an estimated driving range of up to 373 miles, or 600 kilometers, on a single charge. High-voltage architecture allows the vehicle to support DC fast charging at speeds up to 350 kW. At peak charging capacity, the battery charges from 10 to 80 percent in 22 minutes, while a rapid 10-minute pit stop adds up to 137 miles of range. Visually, the silhouette stays true to the brand's DNA but introduces subtle aerodynamic updates, including a modified grille design and unique alloy wheels. In the absence of a traditional exhaust note, engineers developed a dedicated soundscape for the vehicle to blur the lines between music and engineering.By replacing an internal combustion engine with a dense battery pack, JLR altered the physical dynamics of its sporting SUV. a4977d3fa4:9d195646d1682011.title: Xbox Finally Unlocks Mythic Achievements, One of Its Most Player-Requested Features
a4977d3fa4:9d195646d1682011.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:9d195646d1682011.summary: Summary Xbox Insiders can now preview Mythic Achievements, a permanent status earned by completing every original achievement in a gameThe system applies retroactively, so previously completed games, including Xbox 360 titles, may already carry Mythic statusA new Gaming tab, progress bars, and "add-on" labels make it clear what counts toward Mythic and what's still left Xbox is giving its most dedicated players a new marker to chase with Mythic Achievements, a profile distinction now in early testing with Xbox Insiders. The status goes to anyone who clears every original achievement in a game. It also looks backward: titles players finished years ago, Xbox 360 releases included, have already been upgraded without any extra effort.The qualifying rule is intentionally tight. Only a game's original achievement list counts toward Mythic, and anything added later through DLC or post-launch updates is excluded. New content arriving months after a player's final unlock won't reopen a game they've already finished. Xbox stated the permanence directly in its announcement: "once you've earned Mythic status, it's yours to keep."That backward-looking design is the feature's quiet headline. Achievements and Gamerscore arrived with the Xbox 360 in 2005, so the retroactive sweep reaches back across roughly two decades of play. For long-time completionists, opening a profile could mean finding a shelf of old victories newly marked as Mythic.Those milestones now live in a dedicated Gaming tab on each profile. It collects a player's achievements, shows progress toward their next Gamerscore milestone badge, and lists every completed game. Mythic entries get a distinct frame so they stand out from the rest of a player's history, and the tab can be viewed on friends' profiles too, turning completion into something players can compare.Players still working toward Mythic get clearer tracking. A progress bar now sits at the top of each game's achievement list, with a filter that narrows…

The announcement is billed as a historic run, with the residency positioned as the first by a K-pop artist in Las Vegas.The new dates reshape the run without adding a third weekend. Rather than extending into December, the two additions stretch the existing weekends at both ends. A Thursday, November 12 show now opens the first weekend, and a Sunday, November 29 show closes the second. The final schedule runs in two three-night blocks: November 12 through 14 and November 27 through 29.The original four dates cleared in under 10 minutes, a sellout pace that effectively made the additional shows inevitable. General on-sale for the full run opens September 30.The residency also arrives with fresh momentum behind it. "SaWaDiKa," LISA's newest single, came with a music video shot in her hometown of Bangkok, and the clip passed 70.8 million views within its first 24 hours. The track is the lead release from PRESS PLAY, her upcoming EP due October 23. LISA gave the song its first televised performance at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, where she also won Best Pop for "Dream." The win is billed as the first in that category for a K-pop artist.Outside music, her feature documentary Always Lalisa premiered in Toronto and opens in cinemas worldwide on October 12. It gives fans a second big-screen LISA moment before the Colosseum shows begin. She recently also announced her Meta Glasses by LISA collaboration, talking to Hypebeast about her design…

a4977d3fa4:b790638e51285aca.title: LNGSHOT Fronts AAPE’s FW26 Campaign
a4977d3fa4:b790638e51285aca.author: info@hypebeast.com (Hypebeast)
a4977d3fa4:b790638e51285aca.summary: AAPE has unveiled its Fall/Winter 2026 campaign, enlisting rising four-member K-pop group LNGSHOT to front the season. Launched by MORE VISION, the label founded by Korean singer-producer Jay Park, the group brings its distinctive musical identity and attitude to the campaign, channeling AAPE’s rebellious streetwear ethos across the latest collection.The campaign is divided between the “Street Drift” and “Underground” lines. Rooted in skate culture and the rhythm of city life, “Street Drift” combines sportswear and workwear influences through versatile, layered silhouettes. Graffiti-inspired artwork, splash ink graphics and subway-inspired motifs appear across gradient camouflage jerseys, hooded workwear jackets, utility vests and washed camouflage denim. Jacquard denim and waffle knits bring additional texture, while powder blue, yellow and purple are accented by royal blue and light grey throughout the range.Turning toward a rawer subcultural aesthetic, “Underground” draws from hip-hop culture, experimental design and the nostalgic visuals of 1980s horror films. A newly developed tiger-stripe camouflage forms the collection’s visual foundation, complemented by retro horror zombie graphics, barbed wire motifs and Trompe-l'œil prints. Key pieces include a wrestling mask hoodie, detachable work pants, 3D-cut denim and a CWU-45P military flight jacket, finished with vintage washes and DIY-inspired patchwork for an intentionally distressed, high-impact look.The AAPE FW26 collection is now rolling out at select physical stores and the brand's official online store. d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.title: The Scramble for the Open Seas
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.author: Michael Albertus
d006da4fe3:22627d45ff3f3498.summary: Over the last half millennium, societies around the globe competed to divide up the world’s land. Nearly every square inch of soil outside Antarctica is now owned and tucked within national borders. But the oceans have largely been spared that fate. There were times throughout history when countries tried to gate and regulate the seas, but they were too vast to be controlled for long periods. During the Cold War, as technology made it far easier to imagine partitioning the world’s waterways and seabeds, great powers avoided an unrestrained race to grab the oceans. Most governments agreed to deal with them through a patchwork of treaties and multilateral bodies that sought to guarantee freedom of navigation in international waters and assign coastal seabeds to adjacent littoral states.

d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.title: The Trouble With the Nuclear-AI Analogy
d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.author: Christopher LaRoche, Ankit Panda
d006da4fe3:a574167532370f34.summary: In humanity’s quest to constrain the dangers from fast-advancing artificial intelligence, many have looked to the most revolutionary technology that preceded it: nuclear weapons. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has called artificial intelligence “far more dangerous than nukes.” Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, who assigns The Making of the Atomic Bomb to employees and has likened himself to the Manhattan Project scientist Leo Szilard, describes the most powerful AI models as “weaponizable nuclear materials.” When asked how a technology such as AI can be regulated, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman often references the world’s nuclear materials watchdog, the International Atomic Energy Agency. Even the director of the CIA, John Ratcliffe, has made the same comparison.These comparisons capture real parallels. Like nuclear weapons, frontier AI is powerful and hard to control. Like nuclear technology, it can be used for good or for ill. And like the Cold War arms race, the race for AI breakthroughs may reorder the global balance of power. The nuclear analogy, then, seems to offer a blueprint for how to effectively govern a promising but potentially dangerous technology such as AI.

fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.title: What Does Venture Capital Actually Finance ? Scale and Structure around the World
fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.author: Mauro, Paolo
fc066e842d:b24979dbe73586d0.summary: Venture capital is widely viewed as financing knowledge-intensive, R&D-driven startups, but owing to data constraints, this view has been based largely on high-income economies. By taking a global perspective, this paper documents that what venture capital finances differs systematically across economies, varying with institutional and business conditions rather than following a single model. Using a new cross-country dataset that harmonizes firm-level venture capital records with equity issuance data for more than 150 economies, the data shows that VC markets differ across countries not only in scale but in kind. Outside high-income countries, rather than being concentrated in knowledge intangibles, venture capital tilts–at both the sector and firm levels–toward organizational intangibles such as distribution, logistics, and payments. Highlighting the unique features of venture capital, this pattern is absent from public equity markets, where sectoral composition is far more similar across income levels. An accounting decomposition separates venture capital depth into the rate at which firms enter the market and the funding each entrant attracts, and entry accounts for the largest cross-country gaps. Moreover, the business environment is associated with VC primarily through entry, linked both to the size of the market and to the composition of what venture capital finances, the latter through entry into knowledge-intensive sectors in particular.

fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.title: Standardizing Business Process Documentation for Operational Transition: A Case Study of Employee Administration Data Entry at PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk
fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.author: Athira, Celia
fc066e842d:1ada7049cb8f2e03.summary: Organizational transitions that transfer operational activities from internal units to external partners depend heavily on the availability of standardized process documentation. This study examines the business process of Employee Administration (EA) Kedinasan data entry within the Employee & Organization Data Operation (EODO) unit of PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, undertaken as part of the company's preparation to transfer data-entry activities to an external partner, PT Infomedia Nusantara. Using a descriptive-qualitative case study approach grounded in Business Process Management (BPM) theory, the study maps the existing (as-is) process through direct observation, documentation review, and discussion with field supervisors, and evaluates it using SWOT analysis to identify internal and external factors shaping the transition. The findings show that although the EA Kedinasan process already possesses a structured workflow supported by verification and approval checkpoints and a centralized SAP-based system, its documentation remains fragmented across multiple work instructions and lacks an integrated reference that can function effectively as a knowledge-transfer medium for an external partner. The study recommends the consolidation of Business Process diagrams, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, and a Playbook into a single coherent documentation package, which was implemented in part during the internship. Beyond its immediate organizational relevance, the case illustrates a broader tension in business process transitions: technically sound processes can still generate transition risk when explicit-knowledge artifacts are not consolidated for an external audience. The study contributes a practitioner-grounded account of how BPM and knowledge-transfer principles operate in a real outsourcing transition within a large Indonesian state-owned enterprise, and offers implications for organizations preparing similar administrative…

fc066e842d:f89f05c8bc834f39.title: Reversibility as a Factor of Production: A General Theory of the Economics of Error
fc066e842d:f89f05c8bc834f39.author: YAHYA, Ould Amar
fc066e842d:f89f05c8bc834f39.summary: What the Article proposes. All growth is born of trials — projects launched, firms founded, techniques attempted — and most trials fail. What each society does with those failures is, this Article argues, the most decisive and least measured variable in economics. Where honest failure leaves its author with his capabilities, his assets and his reputation, people try often, learn fast and prosper; where failure destroys — perpetual debt, stigma, disqualification, personal ruin — the most rational agents stop trying, and the economy dies out for want of experiments. The Article gives this intuition a complete theoretical body: it introduces the “reversibility coefficient ρ, ” the fraction of his capabilities an agent retains after an honest failure, elevates it to a factor of production on a par with capital and labor, and endows it with a law of formation, a geometry, theorems and an instrument of measurement. A pharmaceutical laboratory screens ten thousand molecules to retain a single one for a drug; the 9, 999 failures are not losses but precious information — each closes a path, sharpens the map and brings the medicine closer, to the point that laboratories parse their competitors’ failures line by line. The Article asks that the economy as a whole treat error as the laboratory treats it — a raw material of discovery — and not as a punitive society treats it, where a mistake closes the future to whoever makes it. The thesis holds that development begins neither with savings nor with capital goods, but when falling ceases to mean being destroyed. Why reversibility truly is a factor of production. Economic science admits as a factor of production any magnitude that meets three criteria: it is scarce and costly to produce; its increase raises output, other factors held constant; and it accumulates and depreciates like a stock. Reversibility passes all three tests. It is productive: with capital, labor and talent held identical, ρ governs both the number of trials…

fc066e842d:dea68a113565c652.title: Towards a dynamic conceptualisation of the Regional Innovation System: The Systemic Knowledge Network Continuum
fc066e842d:dea68a113565c652.author: Nick Clifton
fc066e842d:dea68a113565c652.summary: The Regional Innovation Systems (RIS) framework explains regional innovation performance primarily through structural conditions and external knowledge flows. While this perspective has generated influential typologies and policy models, it offers limited insight into how RISs emerge and transform from within. This paper advances a dynamic perspective that conceptualises RIS development as a continuum from fragmented interaction to systemic integration. We argue that generative network mechanisms and systemic dimensions co-evolve recursively, enabling or constraining the formation of integrated RISs. By shifting attention from static structures to self-reinforcing dynamics, the framework provides a foundation for understanding RIS formation, transformation, and reversibility, and suggests a more adaptive, mechanism-oriented approach to policy.

fc066e842d:24d84e140192b3ce.title: Discovering Green: The Role of Organizational and Network Embeddedness in the Shift Toward Sustainability Research
fc066e842d:24d84e140192b3ce.author: Tom Broekel
fc066e842d:24d84e140192b3ce.summary: This study examines researchersâ€™ diversification into sustainability research, distinguishing between initial entry and subsequent engagement intensity. While the existing literature emphasises individual-level drivers, we argue that such diversification is also shaped by organisational and relational contexts. Using bibliometric data from the University of Stavanger, Norway, we show that network distance to sustainability-active colleagues is a key predictor: researchers who are structurally closer to engaged peers are more likely to enter the field and deepen their involvement. By contrast, department- and faculty-level sustainability activities show weaker, more context-dependent associations, with department-level effects disappearing once network variables are included. The findings highlight the importance of intra-organisational knowledge networks for sustainability-oriented research transitions.
